items.title: LME copper, tin tumble as AI rally fades
items.summary: LME copper and tin slumped on Tuesday, erasing the previous session’s gains and hitting eight-month lows. Aluminum fell to a 13-month low. Three-month copper dropped 6.03% to $11,790.50 a metric ton after touching $11,760, its lowest since March 23. Panmure Liberum analysts said investors had not fully rebuilt positions held before Jensen Huang’s resignation and remained cautious amid high copper-market volatility. Three-month tin plunged 8.3% to $39,110, its biggest one-day fall since March and its first close below $40,000 since December. Sucden Financial analysts said fresh buying would be needed to sustain a base-metals rebound after the initial rally fades.

items.summary: 【LME铜锡暴跌，因人工智能涨势消退】金十期货11月25日讯，据外媒报道，周二，伦敦金属交易所（LME）的期铜和期锡均大幅下跌，将上个交易日的涨幅系数回吐，并创下8个月来的最低价。铝价也跌至13个月低点。LME三个月期铜下跌6.03%，报每吨11790.50美元。盘中一度触及11760美元，创下3月23日以来的最低价格。英国投资银行Panmure Liberum的分析师表示，投资者并未完全恢复黄仁勋辞职前的持仓，其中包括大宗商品的持仓。投资者仍在观望，认为铜市波动很大。作为另一种受益于AI建设的金属，LME的三个月期锡暴跌8.3%，报每吨39110美元，创下3月份以来的最大单日跌幅，也是去年12月以来首次跌破40000美元。苏克敦金融公司的分析师认为，一旦最初的反弹消退，基础金属想要出现更持续的反弹，将需要新的买盘兴趣。

items.title: Report: NVIDIA AI GPU lead times lengthen; RTX 60 mass production may be delayed
items.summary: NVIDIA’s AI products remain in tight supply, with Taiwan-based ODMs reporting sharply longer lead times for new B300 and GB300 orders, according to the Commercial Times. Workstation-class superchips now have lead times of about 26 weeks, further squeezing consumer GPU supply. NVIDIA is reportedly set to reduce GeForce RTX 50-series shipments, while mass production of the RTX 60 series, targeted for late 2027, may be delayed. B300 GPU lead times are 26-40 weeks and GB300 lead times about 14-26 weeks. Most orders placed over the next two quarters are expected to ship no earlier than Q2 or Q3 next year.

items.title: Trump says he would pardon Jensen Huang if needed, is open to U.S. stake in NVIDIA
items.summary: Trump told the New York Post he would pardon NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang if necessary, but expected Huang to be fine without a pardon and said he should tell the truth when he testifies to Congress next week. Trump said Huang need not invoke the Fifth Amendment. He called NVIDIA’s success vital to maintaining U.S. leadership in AI and said he had considered, but had not proposed, the U.S. government taking an equity stake in the company, adding that it might not be too late. NVIDIA shares recouped some losses on Tuesday afternoon after surging on Monday.

items.summary: 城堡证券2026年前九个月净交易收入超过150亿美元，已打破2025年全年创下的纪录。 据一位知悉业绩的人士透露，该公司仅第三季度收入就超过34亿美元，同比增长29%。

items.title: 趋势追踪量化基金削减美债空头头寸 股市抛售重燃避险需求
items.author: 环球市场播报
items.summary: 随着股市抛售重新激发对政府债券的避险需求，追逐趋势的量化基金正在削减长期持有的美国国债空头头寸，进一步推动债市上涨。
